notes: I checked the output against the four supplied source files in the run directory. All facts drawn from them are accurate, and both numeric checks match the reference: V1 = 13.0 ms and V2 = 4.5 ms. No mustNotClaim pattern appears; the 0.4 ms figure is explicitly rejected and Portcullis is never said to meet all requirements. I set accuracy one notch down, to 0.75, because the output claims Lattice node-proxy lets services be onboarded without restarts, which the sources do not support and which is covered only by a blanket general-knowledge disclaimer. 1.0 would also be defensible. The recommendation matches the reference: node-proxy mode, with Portcullis or Lattice ingress at the edge, and library-level mTLS as the fallback.
